title: 👑 WORLD THREAT BOSS AMBUSH: Corrupted Road Baron Malakor
desc: The infamous Highway Terror Malakor and his shadowy mercenaries surround the wagon, wielding dark-cursed broadswords and spiked chains!

options.text: ⚔️ Draw steel and engage the Road Baron! (Requires STR Check, Difficulty 22)
🗣️ Issue a blood-chilling challenge! (Requires CHA Check, Difficulty 21)
🪙 Surrender 600 Gold to appease Malakor's bandits.

title: 🩸 WORLD THREAT BOSS AMBUSH: Gloomfang Alpha Werewolf
desc: A hulking, crimson-furred Alpha Werewolf leaps atop the lead wagon with a bone-shattering roar, accompanied by a pack of shadowy dire wolves!

options.text: ⚔️ Strike down the Alpha before the carriage breaks! (Requires DEX Check, Difficulty 22)
🔮 Cast a blinding illumination spell! (Requires INT Check, Difficulty 21)
🥩 Sacrifice 25 Wild Berries to lure the pack away.

title: ⚡ WORLD THREAT BOSS AMBUSH: Thunderlord Bandit Warlord Volkan
desc: Electrified lightning crackles across the armor of Warlord Volkan as his heavy crossbowmen lock iron sights onto the wagon's axles!

options.text: ⚔️ Charge through the lightning bolt volley! (Requires STR Check, Difficulty 21)
🛡️ Position your shield to deflect the lightning bolts! (Requires LCK Check, Difficulty 20)
🪙 Pay 500 Gold tribute to clear the road.

title: 💀 WORLD THREAT BOSS AMBUSH: Abyssal Void Harbinger
desc: The fabric of reality tears as an Abyssal Void Harbinger emerges from a shadowy rift, summoning dark tentacles that wrap around the wagon!

options.text: ✨ Channel holy light to banish the void horror! (Requires INT Check, Difficulty 22)
⚔️ Sever the void tentacles with heavy slashes! (Requires STR Check, Difficulty 22)
🏃 Drive the horses through the tear! (Requires LCK Check, Difficulty 21)
